justified_rtl_changes.reason: Initial Icarus 12 compile crashed with return code 139; supplemental Icarus 11 compiled. Replaced enum state type with explicit two-bit localparams and logic registers to investigate simulator compatibility without changing transitions. Icarus 12 still crashed.

Saved diagnostics implicated always_* processing of constant bit selects. Replaced always_comb with always @(*) as a simulator compatibility exception. Transition logic and latency are unchanged; required Icarus 12 compile and simulation passed.

interface_cycle_summary: TopModule(clk, reset, in[7:0], done); synchronous active-high reset. One byte per rising edge. done high immediately after third-byte edge for one cycle; next edge accepts a possible new first byte.
numeric_width_decisions: 8-bit input, one-bit output, two-bit FSM; no arithmetic.
static_review: Complete combinational assignments; nonblocking clocked state; no extra ports, initializers, or latency; standalone DUT has no child dependencies.
coverage: Search discard, all 256 byte values, payload bit-3 combinations, back-to-back messages, resets at all framing phases, synchronous reset within done cycle, deterministic mixed input stream.
snapshots: candidate_initial.sv preserved unchanged; candidate_revision_1.sv and candidate_revision_2.sv preserved; helper snapshots and logs retained.
